input.quote: Charges for applicable Services will be specified in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms. Charges can be specified as one-time, installment, recurring, or usage. IBM will invoice such Charges when they begin or are due as set forth in Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no minimum purchase commitment, committed volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic on Customer: § 4.1 charges are one-time, installment, recurring or usage-based for Services actually ordered under Service Option Attachments/Order Forms, and searches for "minimum", "commit", "shortfall" and volume commitments return nothing. § 11.5 Capacity Planning only allocates responsibility for sizing/requesting capacity, and § 14.11 restricts resale rather than capping Customer usage. Customer also retains a monthly termination-for-convenience right on one month's notice (§ 3.4), so this sits at the preferred position. Noted only: § 3.4(b) preserves any early termination charges specified in Attachment A, which we would review as an exit-cost point under the termination rule rather than as a take-or-pay commitment.
